_comment: Regression: a pure-ESM shared chunk spuriously imports the runtime chunk. shared.js has a side-effect-only import of barrel.js; barrel.js is side-effect-free (eliminated) but has depended_runtime_helper=ToEsm because it does `import cjsDep from './cjs-dep.js'`. patch_module_dependencies propagates ToEsm from the eliminated barrel onto shared.js. compute_cross_chunk_links then adds __toESM to the shared chunk's depended_symbols, producing a spurious rolldown-runtime dep with a dead setter. Both entries directly import cjs-dep.js, keeping the runtime as a separate chunk. The fix guards the chunk.depended_runtime_helper loop in compute_cross_chunk_links to skip helpers not needed by any included module in the chunk.
